summary: Three blocks: an illustrated head, a leader grid in a featured 2 + 3 + 3 rhythm with long bios, and a closing call-to-action card. Needs eight leaders with portraits, titles, LinkedIn links and a 40-word bio.

sections.note: pale-blue ground; very large title with a two-line lead and one filled button left; a flat illustration of people climbing a blue arrow right

centered heading and lead; first row two larger cards (the CEO and growth officer), then two rows of three: portrait top, a white name plate overlapping its lower edge with a LinkedIn icon, bold title in blue, and a six to eight line bio
rounded light card: question heading left, one filled pill button right
